item.title: Reliance Power shares on fire! Anil Ambani’s stock jumps 9.22%, but remains down 59% in a year - should you buy?
item.description: Reliance Power shares rose 9.22% on Thursday, extending a weekly gain to 11.21%, but remain 59% below their year-ago level. Analysts say the rebound may be temporary: resistance sits near ₹20–22, while ₹16 is key support. They advise caution until a decisive breakout confirms a trend reversal.

item.title: IPO, FPO and SME listing rules: SEBI to review framework, says Chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey
item.description: SEBI is reviewing IPO, FPO and SME listing rules, seeking clearer disclosures, stronger oversight of IPO proceeds and lower-cost, more efficient SME listings. Chair Tuhin Kanta Pandey also wants to prepare more businesses for listing and remove inactive firms that may pose shell-company risks.

item.title: MSCI Rejig: LIC, Meesho likely to enter India Standard Index; OFSS, Siemens Energy may be dropped
item.description: JM Financial expects the November 2026 MSCI India Standard Index review could add LIC and Meesho and exclude Oracle Financial Services Software and Siemens Energy India. The changes may generate estimated net passive inflows of about $1.4 billion; final decisions await MSCI’s announcement.
